note: Historical base maps for the journey animation. Both are Library of Congress scans (no rights advisory; free to use and reuse). Both sheets are conic projections, so a simple corner-bounds image overlay in Web Mercator is approximate; for a faithful fit warp with the control points (gdal_translate -gcp ... then gdalwarp -tps -t_srs EPSG:3857) and tile the result. Control points were read off the images (pixel x,y from the top-left of the JPEG) and spot-checked.

mouth of the Crow Wing River
Fond du Lac, west end of Lake Superior

caveats: Conic projection, central meridian 95 W; parallels are arcs that sit 200-500 px lower at the sheet edges than at the centre. Affine is fine along the Mississippi/Minnesota corridor; warp with GCPs for the whole sheet.
Does not reach Pembina or the Red River Settlement.
